label: Phased Plan Drain
description: Point the generic drain at a plan-manager plan and drain it slice-by-slice: each round a fresh agent executes the next drainable slice and hands off the true frontier, and a classified edge derives continue / complete / blocked from the handoff. Plan-first — no initiative required.
best_for: A stable plan already exists and the work is "execute this plan"
Long sequential plans that agents drain over many runs
Continuity across handoffs matters more than parallelism
Plan-first runs with no initiative ceremony
not_for: The plan is exploratory or unstable — use holistic-loop
Items are independent and parallel execution wins — use item-level
Work is small enough to fit in a single backlog item
tradeoffs: Continuity over parallelism — one slice at a time
No plan preparation, review, or backlog reconciliation — the plan is the contract; composing initiative modes layer those on
Progress classification happens at the transition, not as a separate agent round
A blocked or underivable handoff stops the loop for operator attention

prompt.title: Phased Plan Execute Next
prompt.trigger: Operator starts (or the drain loops) the phased-plan-drain execute phase
prompt.purpose: Execute the next drainable slice of the target plan and emit a handoff stating the true frontier.

fields.name: handoff
fields.description: The structured handoff the next round consumes — summary, blockers, next step, changed files, tests, and the true frontier the slice advanced to.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Concise statement of what this execution slice completed.

fields.name: blockers
fields.description: Known blockers that prevent further progress; use a single item such as "none" when there are none.

fields.name: next_step
fields.description: The immediate next operator or agent step after this slice.

fields.name: changed_files
fields.description: Repository paths changed by this slice; use a single item such as "none" when no files changed.

fields.name: tests
fields.description: Validation commands or checks run for this slice.

fields.name: frontier
fields.description: The true continuation frontier: the next comprehensively-completable unit or the exact remainder.

classify.description: Whether the drain should continue with the next slice, has fully completed the plan, or is blocked and needs operator attention.
